title: Royal Espionage
question: What important thing did King Alfred learn when he penetrated the Danish camp of Guthrum?

meanings.usage: 不可数名词，正式用语，指获取敌方情报的秘密活动
可作及物/不及物动词，指进入某地或被允许进入某个组织/团体
常用搭配：disguise sb as sth 把某人伪装成某物
指中世纪四处游历，通过演唱、表演为生的艺人
通常指讲述故事的慢节奏歌曲或诗歌
用于描述和杂技相关的动作、技能或表演
不可数名词，指通过技巧表演幻象、魔术的行为
可形容纪律、管理松散，也可形容绳子等物品不紧
复数名词，通常指某一事件、交易获得的全部收入
可指军事突袭，也可指警方的突击搜查或盗贼的抢劫
可指人集合，也可指组装物品，及物不及物均可
用于形容事物价值、规模小到不值得重视
通常指数量庞大、移动中的人群，可带有贬义
指反复攻击、打扰某人或某物，使其不得安宁
指战争中双方小规模的、非正式的交锋

phrases.usage: 表示“伪装成”，常用作伴随状语，说明主语的状态

examples.en: He disguised himself as a delivery man to get into the building.
examples.zh: 他伪装成快递员进入了那栋大楼。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“定居；安顿下来”，也可指“平静下来；安定下来过稳定生活”

examples.en: After travelling for years, he decided to settle down in the countryside.
examples.zh: 游历多年后，他决定在乡村定居下来。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，意为“安全防范措施”，可搭配take/adopt等动词使用

examples.en: The airport has strengthened security precautions ahead of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期来临前，机场加强了安全防范措施。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，意为“与……相比”，常用于句首或句中作比较状语

examples.en: Compared with last year, our sales have increased by 30% this year.
examples.zh: 和去年相比，我们今年的销售额增长了30%。

phrases.usage: 表示“适合；能胜任”，后接名词或动名词，说明主语的适用性

examples.en: This key is not fit for the front door, you must have taken the wrong one.
examples.zh: 这把钥匙不适合前门，你肯定拿错了。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，意为“依赖；依靠；取决于”，后接名词、代词或从句

examples.en: Whether we will go hiking tomorrow depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 我们明天是否去远足取决于天气。

phrases.usage: 表示“面对；面临”，主语通常是人或组织，后接困难、问题等对象

examples.en: When faced with difficulties, we should try to find solutions instead of complaining.
examples.zh: 面对困难时，我们应该努力寻找解决方法，而不是抱怨。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，意为“在行进中；在移动中；忙个不停”

examples.en: As a sales manager, she is always on the move, visiting different cities every week.
examples.zh: 作为销售经理，她总是忙个不停，每周都要去不同的城市。

phrases.usage: 表示“一系列；一连串”，后接可数名词复数，整体作主语时谓语动词用单数

examples.en: The school has launched a series of activities to promote traditional culture.
examples.zh: 学校推出了一系列活动来推广传统文化。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，意为“充当；担任；起……作用”，说明事物的功能或角色

examples.en: The old sofa in the study can serve as a temporary bed for guests.
examples.zh: 书房里的旧沙发可以充当临时床供客人使用。

sentences.en: Alfred the Great acted as his own spy, visiting Danish camps disguised as a minstrel.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝亲自充当间谍，乔装成吟游诗人，拜访丹麦营地。

sentences.en: In those days wandering minstrels were welcome everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在那些日子里，四处游荡的吟游诗人在任何地方都受到欢迎。

sentences.en: They were not fighting men, and their harp was their passport.
sentences.zh: 他们不是战士，他们的竖琴就是他们的通行证。

sentences.en: Alfred had learned many of their ballads in his youth and could vary his programme with acrobatic tricks and simple conjuring.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德年轻时学过许多他们的民谣，并能通过杂技表演和简单的魔术来丰富他的节目。

sentences.en: While Alfred's little army slowly began to gather at Athelney, the king himself set out to penetrate the camp of Guthrum, the commander of the Danish invaders.
sentences.zh: 当阿尔弗雷德的小部队在阿瑟尔尼缓慢集结时，国王亲自出发，潜入丹麦入侵者指挥官古特伦的营地。

sentences.en: These had settled down for the winter at Chippenham: thither Alfred went.
sentences.zh: 他们在奇彭纳姆安顿下来过冬，阿尔弗雷德也去了那里。

sentences.en: He noticed at once that discipline was slack: the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors, and their security precautions were casual.
sentences.zh: 他立刻注意到纪律松懈：丹麦人有征服者的自信，他们的安全防范措施很随意。

sentences.en: They lived well, on the proceeds of raids on neighbouring regions.
sentences.zh: 他们靠掠夺邻近地区的收益过着富裕的生活。

sentences.en: There they collected women as well as food and drink, and a life of ease had made them soft.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里搜罗了妇女、食物和饮料，安逸的生活使他们变得软弱。

sentences.en: Alfred stayed in the camp a week before he returned to Athelney.
sentences.zh: 阿尔弗雷德在营地待了一周才返回阿瑟尔尼。

sentences.en: The force there assembled was trivial compared with the Danish horde.
sentences.zh: 在那里集结的部队与丹麦大军相比微不足道。

sentences.en: But Alfred had deduced that the Danes were no longer fit for prolonged battle: and that their commissariat had no organization, but depended on irregular raids.
sentences.zh: 但阿尔弗雷德推断丹麦人已不再适合持久战，而且他们的军需供应没有组织，只依赖于不规律的突袭。

sentences.en: So, faced with the Danish advance, Alfred did not risk open battle but harried the enemy.
sentences.zh: 因此，面对丹麦人的进攻，阿尔弗雷德没有冒险进行公开战斗，而是骚扰敌人。

sentences.en: He was constantly on the move, drawing the Danes after him.
sentences.zh: 他不断移动，将丹麦人吸引到他身后。

sentences.en: His patrols halted the raiding parties: hunger assailed the Danish army.
sentences.zh: 他的巡逻队阻止了突袭队伍：饥饿侵袭着丹麦军队。

sentences.en: Now Alfred began a long series of skirmishes -- and within a month the Danes had surrendered.
sentences.zh: 接着，阿尔弗雷德开始了一系列漫长的遭遇战——一个月内丹麦人就投降了。

sentences.en: The episode could reasonably serve as a unique epic of royal espionage!
sentences.zh: 这一事件完全可以作为一场独特的王室谍报史诗！

exercises.prompt: “假扮；伪装；掩饰” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: disguise · /dɪsˈɡaɪz/ · verb · 假扮；伪装；掩饰。常用搭配：disguise sb as sth 把某人伪装成某物

exercises.hint: 主语 + 谓语 + ... , + 过去分词短语 / 过去分词短语 , + 主语 + 谓语 + ...
options: as ... as 比例比较结构
exercises.explain: 过去分词作伴随状语：主语 + 谓语 + ... , + 过去分词短语 / 过去分词短语 , + 主语 + 谓语 + ...：用于简化从句，使句子更简洁，同时说明主语的伴随状态、背景信息等

选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

有多少蜘蛛正在为我们做这项工作呢？
一只停走的表仍然是一只表，可以重新上弦。
蝰蛇毒液对这些猎物几乎能立即见效。

grammar.title: 过去分词作伴随状语
grammar.definition: 过去分词和句子主语构成被动关系，用来补充说明主语的状态，可放在句首或句中，用逗号和主句隔开
grammar.structure: 主语 + 谓语 + ... , + 过去分词短语 / 过去分词短语 , + 主语 + 谓语 + ...
grammar.usage: 用于简化从句，使句子更简洁，同时说明主语的伴随状态、背景信息等

examples.en: Alfred the Great acted as his own spy, visiting Danish camps disguised as a minstrel.
examples.zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝亲自充当间谍，扮作游吟歌手探访丹麦人的营地。

examples.en: Seen from the top of the mountain, the village looks very small.
examples.zh: 从山顶上看，这个村庄显得非常小。

grammar.title: 宾语从句（deduce后接并列宾语从句）
grammar.definition: 在及物动词后作宾语的从句，当动词后有两个及以上的并列宾语从句时，第二个及之后的that通常不能省略
grammar.structure: 主语 + 及物动词 + that + 从句1 + and + that + 从句2
grammar.usage: 用于表达通过推理、判断等得出的多个结论，使逻辑更清晰

examples.en: But Alfred had deduced that the Danes were no longer fit for prolonged battle: and that their commissariat had no organization, but depended on irregular raids.
examples.zh: 但是阿尔弗雷德推断，丹麦人已经不再适合持久战：而且他们的后勤没有组织，全靠不定期的劫掠维持。

examples.en: The survey shows that most citizens are satisfied with the public transport, and that they hope more bike lanes will be built.
examples.zh: 调查显示，大多数市民对公共交通感到满意，并且他们希望能修建更多的自行车道。

patterns.pattern: While + 从句（进行/延续性动作）, 主句

original.en: While Alfred's little army slowly began to gather at Athelney, the king himself set out to penetrate the camp of Guthrum, the commander of the Danish invaders.
original.zh: 当阿尔弗雷德的小部队在阿特尔尼慢慢集结的时候，国王本人则出发潜入了丹麦入侵者指挥官古瑟伦的营地。

examples.en: While the students are busy preparing for the final exam, the teachers are working hard to arrange the examination room.
examples.zh: 当学生们忙着准备期末考试的时候，老师们也在努力布置考场。

examples.en: While my mother was cooking in the kitchen, my father was tidying up the living room.
examples.zh: 当我妈妈在厨房做饭的时候，我爸爸正在整理客厅。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + noticed at once that + 宾语从句

original.en: He noticed at once that discipline was slack: the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors, and their security precautions were casual.
original.zh: 他立刻注意到那里纪律松懈：丹麦人有着征服者的自信，他们的安全防范非常随意。

examples.en: When she entered the office, she noticed at once that the atmosphere was very tense.
examples.zh: 她走进办公室的时候，立刻注意到气氛非常紧张。

examples.en: I noticed at once that he was upset, so I went over to ask what had happened.
examples.zh: 我立刻注意到他心情不好，于是走过去问发生了什么事。

patterns.pattern: So, faced with + 名词, 主语 + did not do sth but did sth

original.en: So, faced with the Danish advance, Alfred did not risk open battle but harried the enemy.
original.zh: 因此，面对丹麦人的进攻，阿尔弗雷德没有冒险打正面战，而是不断骚扰敌军。

examples.en: So, faced with the challenge of the new project, we did not give up easily but tried our best to find a solution.
examples.zh: 因此，面对新项目的挑战，我们没有轻易放弃，而是尽全力寻找解决方案。

examples.en: Faced with his misunderstanding, she did not argue with him but explained the whole thing calmly.
examples.zh: 面对他的误解，她没有和他争吵，而是冷静地解释了整件事。
